newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: BIRZAI DAIRY MAKES OFFICIAL LIST.
newsitem.headline: BIRZAI DAIRY MAKES OFFICIAL LIST.

text.p: Lithuania's bourse said on Monday that its board had accepted Birzai Dairy's application for inclusion on the exchange's official list.

"The board today decided to inlude Birzai Dairy on the official trading list and it will start to be traded on the list from next Monday, May 12," the head of the bourse's listing department, Saulius Malinauskas, told Reuters.
The official list, which is comprised of the market's top blue chip companies, currently includes Rokishkis Cheese, cardboard maker Medienos Plaushas, and Vilniaus Bank and Hermis Bank.

Criteria for inclusion on the list include authorised capital of at least five million litas, a quotation on the A list of at least six months' duration, and the submission of quarterly financial statements to the bourse.
